decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Mega Garchomp's speed actually drops to 92 base, giving around 158 at max investment, which is slower than a lot of scarfers or max-speed threats in Champions, so that's a real risk despite the attack boost it gets.

Running the damage numbers, Mega's Dragon Claw likely OHKOs their Garchomp thanks to the attack boost, while non-mega Dragon Claw only does around 83-100%, possibly not killing in one hit. The speed tiers matter a lot here—if they're also mega their Garchomp slows down too, creating a possible speed tie, and if they're scarfed or max speed non-mega I'd be outsped either way. I'm leaning toward staying non-mega and firing off Dragon Claw first since many opponents mega their own Garchomp, which would slow them down and let me capitalize even if I don't score the OHKO immediately.
